name: Add a product to the cart

When I add "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
Click locator('.inventory_item').filter({ hasText: 'Sauce Labs Backpack' }).locator('button').filter({ hasText: 'Add to cart' })
Then the cart should show 1 item
